options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Energy Link
options.doc:
Enable EnergyLink support.

EnergyLink in MMX2 works as a big HP and Weapon Energy pool that the players can use to request HP
or Weapon Energy whenever they need to.

You make use of this feature by typing /heal <amount> or /refill <amount> in the client.
options.doc_fr:
Activer le support EnergyLink.

EnergyLink in MMX2 fonctionne comme un grand pool d'énergie HP et Arme que les joueurs peuvent utiliser pour demander HP ou Arme Energy chaque fois qu'ils en ont besoin.

Vous utilisez cette fonctionnalité en tapant /heal <amount> ou /refill <amount> dans le client.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

How much HP X will have at the start of the game.

Notes: Going over 32 HP may cause visual bugs in either gameplay or the pause menu. The max HP is capped at 64.

Combien d'unités de HP chaque réservoir Heart fournira à l'utilisateur.

options.name: Jammed Buster
options.doc:
Jams X's buster making it only able to shoot lemons.
Note: This adds another Arms Upgrade into the item pool.
options.doc_fr:
Le buster de Jams X ne peut tirer que des citrons.
Note: Cela ajoute une autre mise à niveau des armes dans le pool d'articles.

options.name: Enhancement Chips
options.doc:
Which chip items will be included in the game.
Do note that this feature REQUIRES enabling pickup items as locations!

Supported enhancement chips:
* "Quick Charge Chip" [MMX5] Halves charge time for X-Buster and Special Weapon shots
* "Speedster Chip" [MMX5] Increases walking speed by 50%
* "Super Recover Chip" [MMX5] Increases recovery from items by 25%
* "Rapid Five Chip" [MMX5] Increases the amount of buster shots on screen to 5
* "Speed Shot Chip" [MMX5] Increases default buster shot (lemons) horizontal speed by 50%
* "Buster Plus Chip" [MMX5] Increases Buster damage by 1
* "Weapon Plus Chip" [MMX6] Increases Weapon damage by 1
* "D-Converter Chip" [MMX6] Refills the active weapon when taking damage
* "D-Barrier Chip" [MMX6] Doubles the I-frames after getting hit
* "Item Plus Chip" [MMX7] Increases item drop rates by roughly 33%
* "Spike Walker Chip" [MMX8] Halves speed when sliding down a wall

options.name: Shoryuken In Pool
options.doc: Adds Shoryuken to the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute Shoryuken à la piscine de l'article.

options.name: X-Hunters Medal Count
options.doc:
How many Maverick Medals are required to allow X-Hunters to spawn on their Arena areas in the main levels.

You have to press SELECT on the map to swap which X-Hunter will be available.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de médailles Maverick sont nécessaires pour permettre aux X-Hunters de frayer sur leurs zones Arena dans les niveaux principaux.

Vous devez appuyer sur SELECT sur la carte pour échanger quel X-Hunter sera disponible.

options.name: Boss Weakness Randomization
options.doc:
Every main boss will have its weakness randomized.

vanilla: Bosses retain their original weaknesses
swapped: Bosses will swap around their weaknesses with other bosses
simple: Bosses will have one random weakness
chaotic_single: Bosses will have one random weakness under the chaotic set
chaotic_double: Bosses will have two random weaknesses under the chaotic set
chaotic_triple: Bosses will have three random weakness under the chaotic set

The chaotic set makes every weapon charge level a separate weakness instead of keeping
them together, meaning that a boss can be weak to Charged Spin Wheel but not its
uncharged version.
options.doc_fr:
Chaque chef principal aura sa faiblesse randomisée.

vanille: Boss conserveront leurs faiblesses originales échangées: Boss échangera autour de leurs faiblesses avec d'autres boss simples: Boss aura une faiblesse aléatoire chaotic single: Boss aura une faiblesse aléatoire sous le jeu chaotic double: Boss aura deux faiblesses aléatoires sous le jeu chaotic triple: Les patrons auront trois faiblesses aléatoires sous le jeu chaotique

Le jeu chaotique fait de chaque niveau de charge d'arme une faiblesse distincte au lieu de les garder ensemble, ce qui signifie qu'un boss peut être faible à Charged Spin Wheel mais pas sa version non chargée.

options.name: Plando Weaknesses
options.doc:
Forces bosses to have a specific weakness. Uses the names that appear on the chaotic weakness set.

Format: 
  Boss Name: ["Weakness Name"]
options.doc_fr:
Force les patrons à avoir une faiblesse spécifique. Utilise les noms qui apparaissent sur l'ensemble de faiblesse chaotique.

Format:
  Boss Name: ["Nom de faiblesse"]

options.name: Boss Weakness Strictness
options.doc:
How strict boss weaknesses will be.

not_strict: How the original game operates
weakness_and_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster to deal damage to the bosses
weakness_and_upgraded_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster charge levels 3 to deal damage to the bosses
only_weakness: Only the weakness will deal damage to the bosses
options.doc_fr:
Comme les faiblesses du patron seront strictes.

not strict: Comment le jeu original fonctionne faible et buster: Ne permettre à la faiblesse et au buster d'infliger des dommages aux patrons faiblesse and upgraded buster : Ne permettre à la faiblesse et à la charge de buster niveaux 3 de causer des dommages aux patrons que faiblesse: Seule la faiblesse va causer des dommages aux patrons

options.name: Boss Randomize HP
options.doc:
Wheter to randomize the boss' hp or not. Mid bosses aren't supported (yet).

off: Bosses' HP will not be randomized
weak: Bosses will have [2,32] HP
regular: Bosses will have [16,48] HP
strong: Bosses will have [32,64] HP
chaotic: Bosses will have [2,64] HP

options.name: Plando HP
options.doc:
Forces bosses to have a specific HP value. Can't go over 64 or lower than 2.
Sigma Virus and mid-stage bosses aren't supported here (yet).
Serges, Violen, Neo Violen and Agile share the same HP value with Agile's data applying to all three.

Format: 
  Boss Name: HP Value
options.doc_fr:
Force les patrons à avoir une valeur HP spécifique. Ne peut pas dépasser 64 ou 2.
Sigma Virus et les patrons de mi-étape ne sont pas pris en charge ici (encore).
Serges, Violen, Neo Violen et Agile partagent la même valeur HP avec les données d'Agile s'appliquant aux trois.

Format:
  Boss Name: Valeur HP

How are X-Hunter Base levels unlocked once you have access to the X-Hunter Base.

  - **All Open**: Tous les niveaux sont débloqués.
